title: Represent subclass category overview prose (8 rules)
description: Modeling-choice item (separate commit). 8 h=18 category headings in classPages each followed by short overview prose then h=13.9 subclass entries, currently ignored:document-structure. Martial Archetypes p25 ('Different fighters choose different approaches...'), Monastic Traditions p28 ('Three traditions of monastic pursuit...'), Sacred Oaths p32 ('Becoming a paladin involves taking vows...'), Ranger Archetypes p37, Roguish Archetypes p40, Sorcerous Origins p44 ('Different sorcerers claim different origins...'), Otherworldly Patrons p50, Arcane Traditions p54 ('The study of wizardry is ancient...'). Decision: emit as source-bounded rule records (consistent with racial-traits/magic-items/etc overview-prose-as-rule pattern). New parseSubclassOverviews(classPages) targeted parser: for each known category title at h>=16, capture following h<13 prose until next heading; reflow -> rule:<slug>. Do NOT attach to a specific subclass; preserve source boundaries (overview must not absorb first subclass entry). Add 8 keys to EXPECTED_SRD_5_1_RULE_KEYS + coverage. Sentinels per category. Verify Ranger p37 / Roguish p40 / Otherworldly p50 exact text from PDF before finalizing.
close_reason: Implemented in PR #227 (branch eshyra-g9im-intro-prose). 12 new rule records (rule:feats, rule:conditions, rule:using-ability-scores, rule:appendix-mm-b-nonplayer-characters, 8 subclass overviews); all 12 headings reclassified from ignored:document-structure to record. Sentinels + coverage assertions added. verify:dnd5e-srd-pack + verify:worktree green.
